item.dc:creator: vapvarun
item.content:encoded:
The Easiest Way to Get Your New Job

Find jobs, create trackable resumes and enrich your applications.

[jobmate_job_search_filter form_layout="horizontal" label_color="#fff" background_color="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)"]

Popular Job Types

Find a job

Freelance

2 positions

Full Time

3 positions

Internship

2 positions

Part Time

3 positions

Temporary

2 positions

Resume Listings

Find a Resume

[jobmate_resume_listing resume_list_layout="resume-list-card-view" per_row="3" enable_slider="1"]

Jobs Listings

Find a job

[jobmate_job_listing job_list_layout="job-list-default-view" per_page="5"] Browse all jobs

Browse Hundreds of Jobs

Search, find and apply for jobs directly on your mobile device or desktop. Manage all of the jobs you have applied to from a convenience secure dashboard.

Jobmate Site Stats

Here we list our site stats and how many people we've helped find a job and companies have found recruits

0 + Job Posted 0 + Job Filled 0 + Companies 0 + Members

Join Thousands of Companies That Rely on Jobmate

Jobmate offers a way to completely optimize your entire recruiting process. Find better candidates, conduct more focused interviews, and make data-driven hiring decisions.

Contact Us

Our Testimonial

John Anderson

- Branding Manager
I have dealt with various recruitment portals but the kind of services Jobmate offers are outstanding. The portal is very user friendly and quick in responding to the user’s requirements.

Camille Gail

- Branding Manager
Jobmate is a great platform for talent sourcing, a wide range of profiles from all specialties is available, and the site is very much user friendly. The team is very helpful!

Richard Sanders

- Branding Manager
My experience with Jobmate has been incredible. They have a comprehensive database with a varied range of profiles spanning nationalities and professions.

Got a question?

Let us now about your issue and a Professional will reach you out. Contact Us

From Our Blogs

A better career is out there. We'll help you find it to use.

Our Testimonial

Click edit button to change this text. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

John Anderson

- Branding Manager
I have dealt with various recruitment portals but the kind of services Jobmate offers are outstanding. The portal is very user friendly and quick in responding to the user’s requirements.

Camille Gail

- Branding Manager
Jobmate is a great platform for talent sourcing, a wide range of profiles from all specialties is available, and the site is very much user friendly. The team is very helpful!

Richard Sanders

- Branding Manager
My experience with Jobmate has been incredible. They have a comprehensive database with a varied range of profiles spanning nationalities and professions.

Got a question?

Let us now about your issue and a Professional will reach you out. Contact Us

A user friendly Job portal

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Ut elit tellus.

HOW IT WORKS

Find Jobs, Employment & Career Opportunities

Register an account

Post a job to tell us about your project. We'll quickly match you with the right freelancers.

Specify & search your job

Browse profiles, reviews, and proposals then interview top candidates. Hire a favorite and begin your project.

Apply for job

Use the Upwork platform to chat, share files, and collaborate from your desktop or on the go.

RECOMMEND JOBS

Find Jobs, Employment & Career Opportunities

[jobmate_job_listing job_list_layout="job-list-default-view" per_page="6"] Browse Now 0 + Job Posted 0 + Job Filled 0 + Companies 0 + Members

RECOMMEND RESUME

Find Resume, Employment & Career Opportunities

[jobmate_resume_listing resume_list_layout="resume-list-default-view" per_page="6"] Browse Now

Fully Responsive & Compatible with All Devices

Design of Jobmate Theme is dedicated mobile design that looks perfect on all devices it has best responsive sliders that works smooth on mobile and tablets

OUR TESTIMONIALS

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

John Anderson

- Branding Manager
I have dealt with various recruitment portals but the kind of services Jobmate offers are outstanding. The portal is very user friendly and quick in responding to the user’s requirements.

Camille Gail

- Branding Manager
Jobmate is a great platform for talent sourcing, a wide range of profiles from all specialties is available, and the site is very much user friendly. The team is very helpful!

Richard Sanders

- Branding Manager
My experience with Jobmate has been incredible. They have a comprehensive database with a varied range of profiles spanning nationalities and professions.

GOT A QUESTION?

Let us now about your issue and a Professional will reach you out. Contact Us

CAREER ADVICE

A better career is out there. We'll help you find it to use.

item.title: Skills Training Gap Among Employees Revealed
item.dc:creator: vapvarun
item.content:encoded:
Queequeg removed himself to just beyond the head of the sleeper, and lighted his tomahawk pipe. We kept the pipe passing over the sleeper, from one to the other. Meanwhile, upon questioning him in his broken fashion, Queequeg gave me to understand that, in his land, owing to the absence of settees and sofas of all sorts, the king, chiefs, and great people generally, were in the custom of fattening some of the lower orders for ottomans.
I was going to warn ye against — but never mind, never mind — it’s all one, all in the family too — sharp frost this morning, ain’t it? The cabin entrance was locked within; the hatches were all on, and lumbered with coils of rigging. Going forward to the forecastle, we found the slide of the scuttle open. Seeing a light, we went down, and found only an old rigger there, wrapped in a tattered pea-jacket. He was thrown at whole length upon two chests, his face downwards and inclosed in his folded arms. The profoundest slumber slept upon him.
But it seemed that, when on the wharf, Queequeg had not at all noticed what I now alluded to; hence I would have thought myself to have been optically deceived in that matter, were it not for Elijah’s otherwise inexplicable question. But I beat the thing down; and again marking the sleeper, jocularly hinted to Queequeg that perhaps we had best sit up with the body; telling him to establish himself accordingly. He put his hand upon the sleeper’s rear, as though feeling if it was soft enough; and then, without more ado, sat quietly down there.

But I beat the thing down; and again marking the sleeper, jocularly hinted to Queequeg that perhaps we had best sit up with the body; telling him to establish himself accordingly. He put his hand upon the sleeper’s rear, as though feeling if it was soft enough; and then, without more ado, sat quietly down there.
